title: No Man's Sky
description: Read from the newest save file by nms-exporter. Anything marked projected is extrapolated from the save's own timestamps at the game's rates.

panels.title: Where
panels.description: The game's own save summary

panels.title: Save age
panels.description: How long ago the game last wrote a save. Everything marked projected is extrapolated from that point.

panels.title: Portal glyphs
panels.description: The current system's portal code: 0-9 A-F stand for the sixteen glyphs

panels.title: Galactic address
panels.description: Signal-booster form of the same location

panels.title: Refiners
panels.description: Ready to collect = finished refiners that still hold output

panels.title: Refiners
panels.description: Newest state per refiner. Output and input are projected forward using the recipe's rate.

panels.title: Running refiners: input left, projected

targets.expr: nms_refiner_input_amount and on(refiner, recipe, output) nms_refiner_active == 1

panels.description: Only refiners with work left; empty means nothing is running

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Extractors plus supply depots, projected from the last save at the measured rate

panels.title: Farms
panels.description: Rate is measured from consecutive saves once two differing fill levels exist; until then it assumes a class-C hotspot.

panels.title: Expeditions
panels.description: Event results only update while the game runs; the timing is projected from departure.

panels.title: Frigates
panels.description: Roll = stats less what traits and rank-ups added, clamped to the community's -5..14 scale (NMSCD frigate calculator). 14 is the best roll the game makes.

panels.title: Top 20 by amount
panels.description: Every container summed: exosuit, ships, freighter, storage, exocraft. Supply depots are on the farms row.

panels.title: Where is it?
panels.description: Pick items in the Item selector above, or type in the column filter

panels.title: Totals over time
panels.description: Top eight of the selected items

panels.title: Plants by kind
panels.description: In stock = how much of what the plant yields you hold across every container

panels.title: Missions
panels.description: Hints, wiki pages and lore flags are left out

panels.title: In progress, closest to done first
panels.description: From the game's mission tables: the current objective and the mission's own reward entries

panels.title: Placement by inventory
panels.description: Wasted = a supercharged slot that is empty or holds a fixed technology instead of an upgrade module

panels.title: Moves
panels.description: Every stack sitting outside its planned container. Move things in game and the list shrinks on the next save.

panels.title: Known blueprints short of stock, by the ingredient in the way
panels.description: The Crafting dashboard has the per-item detail

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Collector = save decoded and metrics current; Scrape = VictoriaMetrics reaching the exporter
